description: Presidential Secretariat - Published the Prorogue Parliament w.e.f. 27.10.2018 and fix 16.11.2018 for the commencement of the next session
reasoning: The gazette content is a proclamation by the President proroguing Parliament and summoning it to meet on a future date. This directly relates to the scheduling and summoning of a parliamentary session, which falls under the electoral and parliamentary processes category (Elections Gazettes).
